title: What Fighting Your Phone Actually Takes (It's Not a 30-Day Detox)
caption:
Fighting your phone isn't a 30-day detox. There's no finish line on this one, and pretending there is sets you up to quit the first time you fail.

The algorithm has more data on you than your own mother does and it never sleeps. You won't out-willpower a system built by thousands of people to win. You have to out-structure it: fewer notifications, less access, more friction between you and the feed.

Take every thought captive to obey Christ (2 Corinthians 10:5). Even the thought that says one more scroll won't matter.

Losing a round tonight doesn't mean you've lost the fight. Get up tomorrow and fight it again.
